settings.heading: Join the Baudie collective
settings.subheading: We'd love for you to help spread the word about plant-forward products that actually work. Share what you love and earn doing it.

settings.heading: Generous commission
settings.text: Earn on every sale you drive with your unique code and link.

settings.heading: Evergreen code
settings.text: A reusable discount code to share with your community any time.

settings.heading: Long cookie window
settings.text: A generous attribution window so you get credit for the sales you inspire.

settings.heading: Free product
settings.text: Get the products you'll be sharing, on us.

settings.heading: Early access
settings.text: Be first to try new launches, sales, and limited drops.

settings.heading: Dedicated support
settings.text: A real person on our team to help you succeed.

settings.heading: Why join
settings.intro: Perks designed to reward the people who spread the word.

settings.heading: Clean, confident, for every body
settings.body: Baudie makes plant-forward deodorant enhancers built on inclusivity, simplicity, and transparency. We believe in real ingredients and feeling your most confident self — and in partnering with people who share those values.

settings.heading: A voice your community trusts
settings.body: You choose clean, thoughtful products and love sharing what genuinely works. Whether you have a large following or a close-knit community, if you inspire the people around you, we'd love to partner with you.

settings.heading: 1. Apply
settings.text: Fill out the short form below to join the program.

settings.heading: 2. Share
settings.text: Get your unique code and link, and share what you love.

settings.heading: 3. Earn
settings.text: Earn commission on every sale you drive.

settings.heading: Apply to the program
settings.intro: Fill out the form below and we'll be in touch.

settings.question: How much can I earn?
settings.answer: You earn a commission on every sale made with your code or link. Full details are shared when you're approved.

settings.question: Who can apply?
settings.answer: Anyone who loves Baudie and shares it authentically with their community.

settings.question: How do I get paid?
settings.answer: Payouts are handled automatically through our affiliate platform, Social Snowball.
